name: dewantech-todo
description: DewanTech To-Do — full-stack, offline-first, installable task manager

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.dev:memory: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev:memory -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace client && npm run build --workspace server
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace server && npm run test --workspace client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace server && npm run typecheck --workspace client
